Here are three friendlier options you can use — all keep the Friday deadline and the escalation if it’s not returned:

1) "Quick reminder: the security questionnaire was due on the 14th. Could you send it by Friday? If it’s not back by then, I’ll need to raise it with Marcus."

2) "Hi — just checking in about the security questionnaire (due on the 14th). Can you get it to me by Friday? If that won’t work, I’ll have to escalate to Marcus."

3) "Hey — reminder that the security questionnaire was due on the 14th. Please try to return it by Friday; if not, I’ll need to bring it to Marcus’s attention."

Say which tone you prefer and I can tweak it (more formal, more casual, or include their name).
